source_control_rules: Folio counts are not surface-area counts; dimensions are required before quantitative compression claims.
Summary, translation and copy must remain separate relation labels.
Parallel local source states such as vol.58/28 and vol.59/23 should not be ordered into a stemma without textual/handwriting comparison.
Published graphical provenance practice does not automatically prove identical bracket conventions in the surviving manuscript.
The 1864 large-bundle manifest establishes Khas+English co-custody at bundle level but not exact modern sheet-level wrapper membership.
Imported thick paper is a catalogue material label; maker and manufacture origin remain unresolved.
